title: Which Cohort Really Gets It?
summary: Dr. Ifeoma's TA says the Weekend cohort is struggling. The attempt log tells a different story.

client.name: Dr. Ifeoma Nwosu
brief: My TA keeps flagging the Weekend cohort — their average scores look the worst of the three. I'm about to move one cohort onto the advanced track, and he's pushing for Morning or Afternoon.
But averaging every attempt punishes anyone who tried more than once. I want to know who actually masters the material, not who got it right on the first try.
client.thanks: Weekend it is. They retried because they cared, not because they're behind — I should've seen that myself.

starterSql:
-- Which cohort should move to the advanced track?
-- Careful: a cadet who retries shows up as several rows here.

SELECT *
FROM cadet_attempts
LIMIT 20;

tables.name: cadet_attempts
tables.description: Every submission across the three Academy cohorts this term. A cadet who retries a quiz appears once per attempt.

columns.name: score
columns.desc: Score on that attempt, out of 100

hints.title: Hint 1: Retries aren't new cadets
hints.desc: Someone who tried three times shows up as three rows. Averaging all of them treats their early, low scores as if a different person scored them.

hints.title: Hint 2: Find each cadet's best, first
hints.desc: Group by cadet (and cohort) and take their MAX(score) — that's what they actually know by the end.

hints.title: Hint 3: Then average those bests by cohort
hints.desc: Wrap that as a subquery, then AVG() the best scores GROUP BY cohort, and take the top one.

findings.claim: Which cohort should move to the advanced track?

options.text: Morning — highest average score on record
Weekend — highest average once you count each cadet's best attempt

findings.claim: Why did the TA's read get it backwards?

options.text: He averaged every attempt, so Weekend's early low scores dragged their average down even though they ended strong.
The attempt log is missing rows for the Weekend cohort.
He didn't get it backwards — Morning really is ahead.

successFeedback: Averaging every attempt punishes cadets for retrying. Once you take each cadet's best score, Weekend comes out on top — they kept at it until it clicked.
